body:
This repository has no git remote (`git remote -v` is empty): the code, the
full history, AND the gittoc tracker branch exist only on this machine
(an SD-card-backed Raspberry Pi, per the host OS). The Android release
keystore + keystore.properties are deliberately gitignored, so they exist
only as loose files here unless the android/README backup advice was actually
followed. Concretely: losing this disk loses the project and permanently
loses the ability to ship an updatable APK (a new keystore can't upgrade
installed apps).

This session already hit the fragility sideways: the repo was moved from
/home/claude/empty to /home/claude/shoppinglist at some point, which silently
broke the gittoc worktree pointer and the server/.venv interpreter paths
(both repaired 2026-07-16).

Decide + set up an off-device backup:
- a bare mirror on another host (or a private GitHub/Gitea remote) with a
  push habit/cron, INCLUDING the gittoc branch (`git push <remote> main gittoc`,
  or `git toc remote --set` + autopush);
- a separate, encrypted copy of android/keystore/ + keystore.properties (NOT
  in the git remote);
- confirm the production server's SQLite backup practice from T-58 is actually
  running against the live deployment.

Needs a human decision on where backups should live before any agent can act.
title: Ops: no off-device backup — repo, gittoc tracker, and release keystore exist only on this machine
